title: PrivatBank Mod
description: Mod adds money and a Ukrainian card

🏦 PrivatBank Mod for Minecraft

Bring a real Ukrainian banking atmosphere into Minecraft!
The PrivatBank Mod adds money-themed items that are perfect for roleplay servers, city maps, shops, and realistic gameplay.

💳 What’s Included:

💰 Money
💳 PrivatBank Card
🏦 Banking-themed items
🧾 ATM Block
✨ Detailed textures for modern builds and RP

🎮 Why Download This Mod?

Perfect for Ukrainian RP servers 🇺🇦
Makes cities, stores, and businesses feel more realistic
Great for economy and roleplay ideas
Fits modern Minecraft maps and multiplayer servers
Lightweight and easy to use

🎯 Mod Goal:
The goal of this mod is to create a realistic Ukrainian banking and economy experience inside Minecraft, especially for roleplay, city-building, and multiplayer servers.

🚧 Current Version:
The mod is currently in development.
At the moment, it mainly adds decorative and roleplay items.

❗ The ATM block texture is currently bugged and may appear pink/black because the texture is missing or broken.

🔮 Planned Features:
Functional banking system
Expanded money mechanics
Multiplayer support
Working ATM functionality
Improved textures and models
More banking-related items

📌 Build your own Ukrainian city, bank, or RP world with the PrivatBank Mod!
